title: Omnicom Schedules First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) will publish its first quarter 2026 results on Tuesday, April 28, 2026 after the New York Stock Exchange close of trading. The company will also host a conference call to review such financial results on Tuesday, April 28, 2026, starting at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time. A live webcast of the call will be available at Omnicom's investor relations website, investor.omc.com , along with the related earnings press release and slide presentation.
